Chan Heng Loon is a Singaporean public official who was appointed chairman of the Land Transport Authority on 1 April 2016. He served as permanent secretary in the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology and the Ministry of Transport. Between 2003 and 2017, he served as the chief executive officer of Singapore Press Holdings, and chaired the Urban Redevelopment Authority from 2006 to 2012. He became a member of the Public Service Commission in 2010.

Alan Chan Heng Loon is a Singaporean business executive and civil servant who served as Chairman of the Land Transport Authority from 2016 to 2026. Prior to this, he was Chief Executive Officer of Singapore Press Holdings from 2003 to 2017, having earlier held appointments as Permanent Secretary for Transport and Permanent Secretary for Communications and Information Technology. During his leadership of the transport authority, he oversaw major expansions of the rail network and spearheaded initiatives in public transport electrification and autonomous vehicles.

delta.news: Singaporean psychiatrist who serves as chief resident and vice-chairman of the medical board for patient experience and culture at Ng Teng Fong General Hospital. Diagnosed with stage four lymphoma in late 2012, he completed treatment and joined Ng Teng Fong General Hospital in 2014. He focuses on supporting the mental health and well-being of healthcare colleagues in the workplace.
